svg.title: Keeper start with its standing team (v1.3): every autonomous agent is an OS user; identities come from the key keeper; bring-up is idempotent after a reboot

g.text: Keeper start with its standing team (v1.3): every autonomous agent is an OS user; identities come from the key keeper; bring-up is idempotent after a reboot
boot_id changed; read team[] of product X:
requester open per RST §5, admitted lifecycle required
[for each standing member (keeper first, then orchestrators)]
no parent ACL, group, firewall rules for the UID
uid, home (no change if it already exists)
register (uid, generation, identity path, owner, registration generation);
one-shot flag recorded (API unpublished; dispatcher §14 gate)
derive public key for the path;
public key, registry record (unchanged if known)
host_start under admitted permit; dispatcher invokes the privileged launcher;
agent-side runner starts under the agent UID (jointly gated); closed fence
bind I/O (rooms of product X), mailbox for the identity
issue session token; readiness probe; fence open
see spawn-with-user: new user, new key,
